name: Ezequiel López-Rubio
title: Full Professor, Dept. of Computer Languages and Computer Science, University of Málaga
bio: Ezequiel López-Rubio is a Full Professor at the University of Málaga. His research interests include graph theory, machine learning, computer vision, and neural network architectures. He is the creator of the IsalGraph and IsalSR frameworks and the principal investigator of the ICAI research group.

name: Mario Pascual González
title: Dept. of Computer Languages and Computer Science, University of Málaga
bio: Mario Pascual González is a Bioinformatics B.Sc. student at the University of Málaga. Since 2024 he has been a research collaborator at the Computational Intelligence and Image Analysis group, where he currently holds a research grant. His research interests include deep learning, representation learning, diffusion-based generative models, and biomedical imaging.

name: Karl Thurnhofer-Hemsi
title: Dept. of Computer Languages and Computer Science, University of Málaga
bio: Karl Thurnhofer-Hemsi is an Associate Professor at the University of Málaga and the corresponding author of the IsalSR paper. His interests are machine learning, pattern recognition and image processing. He is the lead author of IsalChem, which applies instruction string encoding to molecular graphs.
